semiconductor_relevance: High — Heart Tech specializes in RFID Carrier ID solutions specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Heart Tech Enterprise Co., Ltd. is a Taiwan-based manufacturer of RFID Carrier ID Read/Write (CIDRW) controllers, focusing on enhancing automation and traceability in semiconductor fabs. With over 35 years of experience, the company provides reliable solutions for FOUP and FOSB tracking, supporting various semiconductor equipment and integration needs.
capabilities: HR4 Series RFID Carrier ID Read/Write Controllers
Integration with Load Ports, EFEMs, and Automated Material Handling Systems

regional_presence.Taiwan: Heart Tech is designed and manufactured in Taiwan, emphasizing local production and technical support.
